lines.zh: 我扇动双翼，慢慢滑过礁顶。
lines.en: I flap my wings and glide over the reef.
My wide wings spread and push the water aside.
I fly low over the sandy floor.

lines.zh: 尾刺拖在后头，划出细纹。
lines.en: My tail spine trails behind, drawing thin lines.

lines.zh: 我拐弯时整个身子侧过来。
lines.en: I bank my whole body into the turn.
The warm water lifts my wingtips.
I rise slowly into the midwater.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼从我翼下穿过。
lines.en: A shoal of small fish passes under my wing.
Two flaps carry me a long way.

lines.zh: 海底的影子里有我的形状。
lines.en: My shape moves in the shadow on the seabed.
I tilt around a coral pillar.
My wing edge brushes the seagrass.
I drop low and slip through the channel.
I sway my tail slowly to hold my course.

lines.zh: 我贴着温水上层慢慢滑。
lines.en: I glide just under the warm surface.

lines.zh: 翼尖划开水面，翻出白边。
lines.en: My wingtip slices the surface into white.

lines.zh: 我慢慢下潜，追着一道光。
lines.en: I sink slowly, chasing a shaft of light.

lines.zh: 我贴着同伴的翼尖滑过去。
lines.en: I slip past my neighbor's wingtip.
I hang in the water, wings barely beating.
The warm ocean is quiet; I drift.

lines.zh: 一只清洁鱼在我翼下忙。
lines.en: A cleaner fish works beneath my wing.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，让水从鳃里过。
lines.en: I hold my jaws wide and flush water through.
My tail spine hangs, swaying with the water.
A boat's shadow slides overhead.
I turn a slow, wide circle.

lines.zh: 沙地上只有我的影子在动。
lines.en: Only my shadow moves on the sand.

lines.zh: 我把翼尖搭在礁石上歇。
lines.en: I rest a wingtip on the rock.

lines.zh: 水里的光斑在我背上走。
lines.en: Patches of light travel across my back.

lines.zh: 我听着远处礁石的动静。
lines.en: I listen to the reef's distant sounds.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼躲进我的影里。
lines.en: A shoal hides in my shadow.

lines.zh: 我打了个呵欠，水进了嘴。
lines.en: I yawn and water rushes in.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，只让水流带我。
lines.en: I barely move, letting the current carry me.
You are on the reef; I circle to look.

lines.zh: 我的大翼投下阴影，你抬头。
lines.en: My wide wing casts a shadow; you look up.
The lamp in your hand shines into the warm water.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚边滑过去。
lines.en: I glide past your feet.
You reach out; I bank away.

lines.zh: 我盯着你背上的氧气瓶。
lines.en: I stare at the tank on your back.
Your shadow stretches along the bottom.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是保持距离。
lines.en: I am not afraid, only keeping distance.

lines.zh: 我抬翼，露出白色的腹面。
lines.en: I lift a wing and show my pale underside.
You back away; I halt where I am.
My wing is bitten through; the edge trembles.
I roll over, my pale belly upward.
Half my tail spine is broken off.

lines.zh: 血雾在我身后拖出一条线。
lines.en: A trail of blood haze follows me.

lines.zh: 我拼命扇翼，还是往下沉。
lines.en: I beat my wings hard and still sink.

lines.zh: 伤口碰到礁石，疼得缩起来。
lines.en: The wound hits rock and I curl up.

lines.zh: 我转过来，想找咬我的东西。
lines.en: I turn, looking for what bit me.
Water over the wound stings like needles.
I hide in the shadow of the reef.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半天扇不动翼。
lines.en: That blow leaves my wings useless for a while.
That cloud of tiny shrimp is far too dense.
The crushed bait you scattered drifts down.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，把浮游物滤进去。
lines.en: I open my mouth and filter the plankton in.

lines.zh: 那片浑水里有吃的味道。
lines.en: That murky patch smells of food.
I circle the light you set out.
A tiny shrimp bumps my lips.
I drift toward that white cloud.
The scent makes my wings spread.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面滤了一大口。
lines.en: I skim the surface for a big mouthful.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在往下沉。
lines.en: The thing in your hand is sinking.
I hit a coral pillar and my wingtip jerks.

lines.zh: 船底压下来，我急忙下沉。
lines.en: A hull bears down; I dive fast.
A shark grazes my wing.
I plough into a shoal, splashing wildly.
My wing slaps the sand and stirs silt.
Who bumped me from below?
A wave shoves me into the rocks.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我转了个圈。
lines.en: The impact spins me right around.

lines.zh: 我甩开缠在翼上的绳子。
lines.en: I shake off the rope caught on my wing.

lines.zh: 尾刺碰到石面，我缩了一下。
lines.en: My tail spine scrapes stone and I flinch.

lines.zh: 温水里，我们一前一后游。
lines.en: In the warm water we swim one behind the other.
I circle my mate, wings beating.
Our wingtips almost touch.

lines.zh: 它翻了个身，我也跟着翻。
lines.en: It rolls over, and I roll with it.
We glide side by side over the reef.
I brush its underside lightly.

lines.zh: 这一片温暖海是我们的。
lines.en: This warm stretch of sea belongs to us.

lines.zh: 我们升起又落下，像在跳舞。
lines.en: We rise and fall as if dancing.
It drifts away; I catch up.
We rarely swim alone.

lines.zh: 我用嘴接住掉下来的东西。
lines.en: I catch the falling thing in my mouth.
It lodges in the crease beneath my wing.

lines.zh: 我把它卷进嘴里，慢慢咽。
lines.en: I roll it in my mouth and swallow slowly.
It is too hard; I butt it twice.
I carry it along for a short stretch.

lines.zh: 它从我嘴里滑走，沉下去。
lines.en: It slips out of my mouth and sinks.
I press the dropped item into the sand.
I try to flick it with my wingtip.
This thing tastes wrong.
I toss my head and throw it back.

lines.zh: 有什么东西咬了我的翼。
lines.en: Something bit my wing.
I turn to find that shadow.
That shark is closing in again.
I fix on the boat that struck me.
There is blood in the water, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 我盯住那道快速游动的背鳍。
lines.en: I fix on that fast-moving dorsal fin.
The target is small but bites hard.

lines.zh: 它躲进礁缝，我看见尾巴。
lines.en: It hides in a crack; I see its tail.
I swing a wide turn to face it.
This time I do not plan to retreat.

lines.zh: 我升高一点，压住它上方。
lines.en: I rise a little and hang above it.

lines.zh: 它往左，我大翼一摆跟上。
lines.en: It goes left; one wingbeat follows.
I circle and cut off its path.
It charges; I tilt aside.
I watch its gills and wait.
It retreats; I follow slowly.

lines.zh: 尾刺竖起来，我准备好了。
lines.en: My tail spine lifts; I am ready.
In no hurry, I make a third circle.
The moment it stops, I press down.

lines.zh: 水花遮住视线，我靠水流判断。
lines.en: The splash blinds me; I read the current.
I slam down with the edge of my wing.
My tail spine lashes out and cuts a line.
This one is repayment for its bite.
I slam in and flip it over.
It bites me; I pin it down.
My wing sweeps through and muddies the water.
I whip my tail across its flank.
The blow is light, but enough to drive it back.
I roll over and strike with my back.
When it is done I rise at once.

lines.zh: 温带海面上，我破水而出。
lines.en: I break the surface of the temperate sea.
Three manta rays fall back together.

lines.zh: 我在水中翻了个身，翼展开。
lines.en: I roll in the water, wings spread wide.
This warm sea suits us.

lines.zh: 我自深水一寸寸升上来。
lines.en: I rise slowly from the deep.

lines.zh: 水面的光刺得我眯起眼。
lines.en: The surface light makes me squint.
The newcomer circles me.

lines.zh: 我跃起，又重重落回水里。
lines.en: I leap and slap back into the sea.
The current lifts my wings.

lines.zh: 我们只有两只，隔得很远。
lines.en: Only two of us, and far apart.

lines.zh: 水热得发烫，我往深处逃。
lines.en: The water grows hot; I flee deeper.

lines.zh: 跃出水面后，我砸在礁石上。
lines.en: After leaping, I crash onto the rocks.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的翼压得我喘不过气。
lines.en: Out of water my wings crush the breath from me.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的翼掀得翻过来。
lines.en: The blast flips my wing over.
An arrowhead tears through my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 麻意顺着翼骨爬到全身。
lines.en: Numbness crawls along my wing bones.

lines.zh: 滤不到浮游物，我越来越轻。
lines.en: With no plankton I grow lighter and weaker.

lines.zh: 雷光劈开海面，我僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning splits the sea and I freeze.

lines.zh: 没有水，我的翼只能空扇。
lines.en: With no water, my wings beat at nothing.
